lines.source: From Hana's notebook:
lines.text: 摘自小花的笔记本：

lines.source: {size=34}Lanterns: 40.{/size} Paper: enough. Glue: {color=#d04040}not enough{/color}.
lines.text: {size=34}灯笼：40个。{/size}纸：够了。胶水：{color=#d04040}不够{/color}。

lines.source: Reasons to smile tonight: [hana_heart], at least.
lines.text: 今晚微笑的理由：至少[hana_heart]个。

lines.source: The cicadas went quiet.{w=600} Then the bell rang.
lines.text: 蝉声停了。{w=600}接着，铃声响了。

lines.source: Ah! The glue!
lines.text: 啊！胶水！

lines.source: I brought extra. Obviously.
lines.text: 我多带了一些。理所当然。

lines.source: I'll run to the shop. Wait here!
lines.text: 我去商店跑一趟。在这儿等我！

lines.source: Where do we watch the fireworks?
lines.text: 我们在哪里看烟花？

lines.source: By the river.
lines.text: 在河边。

lines.source: In the sunflower field.
lines.text: 在向日葵田里。

lines.source: The lanterns look like stars that fell into the water.
lines.text: 灯笼就像落进水里的星星。

lines.source: {speed=12}I'm glad it's you here.{/speed}
lines.text: {speed=12}还好在这里的人是你。{/speed}

lines.source: {shake}Boom.{/shake} The sky opened up in colors.{alt=Fireworks burst over the river.}
lines.text: {shake}砰！{/shake}夜空绽放出缤纷的色彩。{alt=烟花在河面上空绽放。}

lines.source: For a moment, nobody said anything.
lines.text: 有那么一会儿，谁都没有说话。

lines.source: In the evening the sunflowers face west. Like they're waving goodbye.
lines.text: 傍晚的时候，向日葵会朝向西边。就像在挥手告别。

lines.source: The {select path: field="field" other="river"} glowed gold until the first firework.
lines.text: {select path: field="田野" other="河边"}一直闪着金光，直到第一朵烟花升起。

lines.source: Same time next summer? Promise?
lines.text: 明年夏天，还是这个时候？说好了哦？

lines.source: I promised. It was the easiest promise I ever made.
lines.text: 我答应了。那是我做过最容易的承诺。

lines.source: Thanks for today. Really.
lines.text: 今天谢谢你。真的。

lines.source: We walked home slowly, carrying the empty glue bottles.
lines.text: 我们拿着空胶水瓶，慢慢走回家。

lines.source: Next year, I'm buying the food. You owe me.
lines.text: 明年吃的东西我来买。你欠我一次。

lines.source: Somehow, that sounded like an invitation.
lines.text: 不知为什么，这听起来像是一个邀请。

lines.source: Thank you for playing Sunflower Days.
lines.text: 感谢你游玩《向日葵的日子》。

lines.source: Summer vacation. The sunflowers are taller than I am.
lines.text: 暑假。向日葵比我还高。

lines.source: There you are! I {b}knew{/b} you'd come.
lines.text: 你来了！我就{b}知道{/b}你会来。

lines.source: The festival is tonight. Will you help me get ready?
lines.text: 祭典就在今晚。你能帮我准备吗？

lines.source: What do you say?
lines.text: 你怎么回答？

lines.source: Of course!
lines.text: 当然！

lines.source: I knew I could count on you.
lines.text: 我就知道可以指望你。

lines.source: Only if there's food.
lines.text: 有吃的我就去。

lines.source: There's {i}always{/i} food.
lines.text: 吃的{i}永远{/i}都有。

lines.source: Who else is coming?
lines.text: 还有谁会来？

lines.source: See? It's a whole team now.
lines.text: 看吧？现在是一整个团队了。

lines.source: Someone has to make sure the lanterns don't catch fire.
lines.text: 总得有人确保灯笼不会着火。
